column1: # INTRA-BAR RANGE + VOLUME: the anchor vector for the bar channels (`rangeScale`, `volIdio`),
# which BarsAnchorSuite / bars_anchor_tests re-derive from this file. Editing a graded row moves
# the shipped test bands; editing a `const` row must be accompanied by the code constant it pins.
# Measured 2026-09-01 from folio's Yahoo cache OHLCV (SPY 1993-2026 = w1993, QQQ 1999-2026 =
# w1999; scripts: the session's bars_anchor.py conventions).
#   range x = ln(H/L) per session; with `-overnight` off the model's bar has NO overnight (open
#     = prior close) and the record's overnight variance share (row overnightShare) is the
#     commensurability haircut; with it on that row is GRADED (tol 0.10, since 0.23.1). Rows suffixed `Intraday` are measured against |ln(C/O)| / sign(C-O) — the fair
#     ruler for a no-overnight model; Parkinson recovers real INTRADAY vol at 1.00 exactly,
#     which is what validates the pair of rulers.
#   volume v = ln(volume) minus its rolling 252-session median (the secular share-count trend
#     is not the statistic); rx = ln(x) minus its rolling 252-session median.
#   const rows: the volume channel's frozen structural constants, from the DISTRIBUTED-LAG
#     regression v_t ~ rx_t + rx_{t-1} (0.520/0.142 SPY, 0.503/0.150 QQQ; lag 2 adds 0.04 and
#     is dropped -- a single-lag fit reads 0.59 because it absorbs the lag through the range's
#     own autocorrelation) and its residual (sd 0.29-0.38, acf1 0.51-0.57, acf5/acf1 = 0.84
#     => a slow AR-0.97 component at ~0.55 of residual variance + white noise; residual
#     down-up +0.036 => volDown 0.045 via E[max(-z,0)] = 0.8 on down days). The lag term is
#     what carries the record's CROSS-persistence: corr(rx_t, resid_{t+1}) rows below.
# The `tol` column is the twins' test band half-width (median of 4 model paths, 100y, at
# -rangescale 0.63 -volidio 0.34). Rows with `-` are documentation and grading-time anchors
# (python graders bars_grade.py / vol_grade.py over -barsemit output own the rest); the model's
# disclosed residuals against them: corrRangeAbsR 0.82 vs the intraday 0.79-0.80 and volAcf1
# 0.59 vs 0.64-0.70 (one root: the bridge draws' lag-0 noise). The sign<->vol root is CLOSED by
# `rangeDown` 0.09: range downup 1.137 vs the intraday 1.109-1.142 and volume down-up 0.097 vs
# the intraday-sign gap 0.094-0.098 (rows volDownupGapIntraday) — the raw cc-sign gaps 0.123/
# 0.132 carry the overnight conditioning the model does not have.
